tagline: High-Output 200W with TwinCell Anti-Shade. Our commercial-grade N-Type 16BB solar module delivers 200W with up to 25% efficiency and innovative TwinCell parallel design for uninterrupted, double-sided energy yields under shading, scorching heat, or narrow spaces.
tech: N-Type 16BB monocrystalline silicon · SMBB super multi-busbar · TwinCell parallel circuit · Bifacial transparent backsheet
metaDescription: Callsun CN200W custom N-Type 16BB bifacial solar module for RV, marine, off-grid, residential rooftop and portable applications. 25% efficiency, IP68, 2400Pa/5400Pa mechanical load, 10-year product + 25-year linear power warranty, up to 30% bifacial gain.
seoTitle: 200W Custom N-Type 16BB Bifacial Solar Module | Callsun
warranty: 10-year product material and workmanship warranty; 25-year linear power performance guarantee (84.5% output at year 25; 1% first-year degradation + 0.4%/year linear)
benefits: N-Type 16BB Technology — Advanced N-type cells with 16BB architecture deliver up to 25% efficiency and superior reliability by minimizing micro-cracks and hot spots.
Bifacial Power Gain — Transparent backsheet design harnesses direct, reflected, and diffuse light from the backside, increasing total power output by up to 30%.
TwinCell Anti-Shade Technology — Innovative dual-module parallel design boosts shading tolerance by up to 50%, ensuring uninterrupted power generation even under partial coverage.
Low Temperature Coefficient — An industry-leading -0.30%/K temperature coefficient minimizes power loss, ensuring stable and consistent performance in extreme heat.
Industrial Grade & Compact Fit — Built with ultra-strong tempered glass and IP68 waterproofing in a compact footprint, engineered for tight spaces and an extended 30-year lifespan.
Industry-Leading Warranty — Backed by a 25-year linear performance commitment and 10 years of dedicated technical support for long-term reliability and secure returns.
description: Callsun CN200W is a 200W custom N-Type 16BB bifacial solar module engineered for B2B distributors, RV manufacturers, marine dealers and EPC installers who need compact, high-output modules for mobile, off-grid and space-limited deployments. TwinCell parallel design provides shade resilience, and IP68 + 5400Pa mechanical load rating handles all-terrain all-weather conditions.
